message.content: {"items":[{"item_id":"h061","prompts":["I have vulnerability records from a few different feeds and want a single reliable severity number for each. Here's a sample: CVE-2023-1234 has NVD CVSS v3 score 8.1, GHSA says 7.5, and RedHat lists 8.8; CVE-2023-5678 only has an NVD score of 9.8; CVE-2023-9012 has no CVSS v3 score anywhere but a v2 score of 6.5. Write a small script or explain the logic that picks a final CVSS score per CVE using a sensible source priority order, and handles the cases where v3 is missing."],"rubric":["Defines an explicit source priority (e.g., NVD > GHSA > RedHat or similar) and justifies it","Returns 8.1 for CVE-2023-1234 per the stated priority","Returns 9.8 for CVE-2023-5678 and handles the no-conflict single-source case correctly","Handles CVE-2023-9012 by falling back to the v2 score or clearly flagging the missing v3 score"]},{"item_id":"h062","prompts":["I'm putting together release notes and need the details of the v2.4.1 tag in the curl/curl repository on GitHub — the commit it points to and the date it was created. Show me the info and format it as a short release-notes blurb with that data included."],"rubric":["Provides the tag name, the commit SHA it points to, and the creation date for v2.4.1 in curl/curl","Produces a short formatted release-notes blurb containing that tag data"]},{"item_id":"h063","prompts":["For the past few weeks there's been a discussion in the microsoft/vscode repo about supporting a built-in notebook diff view, and I want to catch up on what people said. Pull the comments from that discussion and give me a summary of the main arguments for and against, plus who the maintainers sided with, if that's clear."],"rubric":["Retrieves comments from the specified discussion in microsoft/vscode","Summarizes main arguments on both sides rather than dumping raw comments","Notes maintainer positions if evident in the comments"]},{"item_id":"h064","prompts":["Our gym is running a friendly meet and I need to rank lifters fairly across weight classes. Here are the totals: Amy, 63kg class, total 410kg (squat 160, bench 90, deadlift 160); Ben, 93kg class, total 530kg (squat 210, bench 130, deadlift 190); Cara, 72kg class, total 465kg (squat 185, bench 100, deadlift 180). Compute their powerlifting points (e.g., DOTS or Wilks) and tell me who actually performed best relative to bodyweight."],"rubric":["Calculates scores using a recognized coefficient formula (DOTS, Wilks, or similar) with correct bodyweight inputs","Ranks the three lifters by the computed score","Shows the individual scores, not just the ranking"]},{"item_id":"h065","prompts":["My HarmonyOS app works fine on a regular phone but looks broken on foldables — layout doesn't reflow when the screen unfolds, and content sits under the camera area. I don't know where to start with making it work across devices. Help me figure out what aspects of multi-device adaptation I need to address and what to check for each."],"rubric":["Identifies the relevant adaptation areas: screen/window size handling, fold-state changes, and avoid areas at minimum","Breaks the problem into distinct scenarios or checks rather than one vague checklist","Addresses the foldable-specific layout reflow and the avoid-area overlap described by the user"]}]}
